The pictured cube. At each of its eight vertices, mark the point on each of its three incident edges that is 1/3 of the way from that vertex to the other end of the edge. For example, P, Q and R are the three points at vertex A. Cut the cube by the plane through the three marked points at each vertex. Describe the shape of the piece containing the centre by giving the number and shape of all its faces. The figure shows only the three marks at A; all eight planes are included in the cuts.
original_question.answer: A convex polyhedron with 8 equilateral triangular faces and 6 equiangular non-regular octagonal faces (a truncated cube with unequal edge lengths).

original_question.question: The pictured rectangular cuboid has side lengths 2, 3 and 4. At each of its eight vertices, mark the point on each of its three incident edges that is 1/2 of the way from that vertex to the other end of the edge. For example, P, Q and R are the three points at vertex A. Cut the rectangular cuboid by the plane through the three marked points at each vertex. Describe the shape of the piece containing the centre by giving the number and shape of all its faces. The figure shows only the three marks at A; all eight planes are included in the cuts.
original_question.answer: A convex polyhedron with 8 congruent scalene triangular faces and 6 rhombic faces (an affine cuboctahedron).

original_question.question: The pictured cube. At each of its eight vertices, mark the point on each of its three incident edges that is 3/4 of the way from that vertex to the other end of the edge. For example, P, Q and R are the three points at vertex A. Cut the cube by the plane through the three marked points at each vertex. Describe the shape of the piece containing the centre by giving the number and shape of all its faces. The figure shows only the three marks at A; all eight planes are included in the cuts.
original_question.answer: A convex polyhedron with 6 square faces and 8 regular hexagonal faces (a truncated octahedron).
